4. Place the duck legs in the pan with the skin sides down (passage 3).
5. Cook the duck legs until the skin is brown, about 3 minutes (passage 3).
6. Place the pan in the oven (passage 3).

8. Spoon 1/4 cup melted butter over the duck and continue cooking for an additional 45 minutes (passage 1).
9. Rub salt, pepper, and paprika into the skin of the duck (passage 1).
10. Remove the roasting pan from the oven and test to make sure the duck is finished cooking (passage 3).
